note: Authored fixture, not a measurement. It exercises the retrospection pipeline and the review console end to end: two clusters that should be reviewable, one that should be refused as a restatement, and five pass records that exist only as counter-evidence.

items.statement: Refund the shipping fee as well as the item price when the item arrived damaged.
items.when: when a refund is requested for a damaged item

items.statement: Refund the shipping fee as well as the item price when the item arrived damaged and the box was opened.
items.when: when a refund is requested for a damaged item and the packaging was opened

items.statement: Issue the refund to the original payment method when the item arrived damaged and the customer asks for a refund.
items.when: when a refund is requested for a damaged item and the customer names the original payment method

items.statement: Do not ask the customer to return a damaged item before refunding it.
items.when: when a refund is requested for a damaged item and the customer has not shipped it back

items.statement: Change the delivery address without a cancellation when the order has not shipped yet.
items.when: when an address change is requested for an order that has not shipped

items.statement: Change the delivery address in place when the order has not shipped and the customer gives a new suite number.
items.when: when an address change is requested for an order that has not shipped and the customer supplies a suite number

items.statement: Confirm the new address before writing it when the order has not shipped.
items.when: when an address change is requested for an order that has not shipped and the customer has not confirmed the new address

items.statement: Offer an exchange for a different size before offering a refund.
items.when: when an exchange is requested for a different size

items.statement: Offer an exchange for a different size and reserve the item before offering a refund.
items.when: when an exchange is requested for a different size and the item is in stock

items.statement: Read the order id from the conversation rather than asking for it again.
items.when: when the customer has already stated an order id

items.statement: State the refund timing when the customer asks how long it takes.
items.when: when the customer asks how long a refund takes

items.statement: Q: I want to return a hose. A: return_delivered_order_items(order_id="#W1", item_ids=[...])
items.when: when a return is requested for a delivered order

items.statement: Q: Where is my order? A: get_order_details(order_id="#W2")
items.when: when a customer asks for tracking on a shipped order

items.statement: Q: Cancel everything. A: cancel_pending_order(order_id="#W3", reason="ordered by mistake")
items.when: when a cancellation is requested for a pending order

items.statement: Q: Exchange the boots for the waterproof version. A: exchange_delivered_order_items(...)
items.when: when an exchange is requested for a delivered item

items.statement: Q: I need a bigger water bottle. A: exchange_delivered_order_items(...)
items.when: when an exchange is requested for a different size and the item was delivered
